telepathic_reader.name: Telepathic Reader
telepathic_reader.oneLine: You know this person almost better than they know themselves, sharing a deep mental synchrony.

clear_reader.name: Clear Reader
clear_reader.oneLine: You have analyzed their self-views and social signals with high clarity and accuracy.

balanced_reader.name: Balanced Observer
balanced_reader.oneLine: You captured their core character traits accurately, though you have different perspectives on certain areas.

casual_explorer.name: Casual Explorer
casual_explorer.oneLine: There are noticeable differences between how they perceive themselves and how you position them.

social_stranger.name: Social Stranger
social_stranger.oneLine: Your social signals and perceptions are on completely different poles. You haven't quite figured them out yet.
